labelRules.direction: sign of the FULL_SAMPLE FULL_TOP120 equal-date mean D10-D1; zero or unmeasurable is NO_CLEAR_PATTERN
precedence: chronology: RECENT_REGIME_CONCENTRATED / PRE_RECENT_ONLY (DATA_INSUFFICIENT if chronology cannot be assessed)

rules.DATA_INSUFFICIENT: FULL_SAMPLE has fewer than minimumDatesFull dates with a decile spread, or a headline statistic is unmeasurable; also when no pre-recent view or no recent view is MEASURABLE (persistence cannot be assessed)
rules.MEGA_CAP_SENSITIVE: under EXCLUDE_BOTH or EXCLUDE_DYNAMIC_TOP2_MARKET_CAP (when MEASURABLE) the mean spread changes sign or falls below weakeningFraction of the full-universe magnitude
rules.OUTLIER_SENSITIVE: mean spread has a non-zero sign AND both the median spread and the mean Spearman do not carry that sign
rules.PERSISTENT_ACROSS_PRE_RECENT_AND_RECENT: full-sample mean, median and Spearman share the direction AND every MEASURABLE pre-recent view and the recent view show it
rules.PRE_RECENT_ONLY: every MEASURABLE pre-recent view shows the direction and TOUCHES_2025_OR_LATER does not
rules.RECENT_REGIME_CONCENTRATED: TOUCHES_2025_OR_LATER shows the direction while no MEASURABLE pre-recent view (PRE_2025_COMPLETE_WINDOW, EXCLUDE_WINDOWS_TOUCHING_2025_OR_2026) shows it
rules.REGIME_DEPENDENT: TREND_OK and TREND_BAD (or VOL_OK and VOL_HIGH) are both MEASURABLE and their mean spreads have opposite non-zero signs

labelRules.showsDirection: a slice 'shows' the direction when it is MEASURABLE and BOTH its mean D10-D1 and mean within-date Spearman carry that sign
labelRules.sliceMinimumDatesRationale: Frozen now, not optimised: the anatomy's H126 block length (26 weekly dates), the smallest date count its own moving-block resampler accepts.
labelRules.weakeningFractionSource: kr-factor-anatomy-v1 interpretation.monotonicityFloor 0.5, the repository's only existing proportion convention; not fitted

limitation: EXPLORATORY_POST_OUTCOME_REGIME_DIAGNOSTIC: designed AFTER the kr-factor-anatomy-v1 outcomes were seen. It can only ask whether already-known relationships are concentrated in particular periods, market states or mega-cap names. It cannot confirm a factor, validate a strategy, rescue kr-model-overlay-portfolio-v1, produce production weights, choose a best factor, tune a threshold or claim independent replication.
limitations: EXPLORATORY_POST_OUTCOME_REGIME_DIAGNOSTIC: designed AFTER the kr-factor-anatomy-v1 outcomes were seen. It can only ask whether already-known relationships are concentrated in particular periods, market states or mega-cap names. It cannot confirm a factor, validate a strategy, rescue kr-model-overlay-portfolio-v1, produce production weights, choose a best factor, tune a threshold or claim independent replication.
Outcome-exposed single historical sample; the new leave-one-out benchmark is post-outcome exploratory.
Top-120 PIT market-cap universe: all large caps; no small-cap statements.
Return basis is the adjusted index with partial observed distributions, not total shareholder return.
Weekly signals overlap; effective independent observations are far fewer than the date count; no intervals or p-values are produced.
Many descriptive views are produced with no multiplicity correction.

questions.Q1: Do the known bookToMarketProxy and recent-price-strength relationships remain when outcome windows touching the unusual 2025-2026 market regime are removed?
questions.Q2: Are momentum / liquidity relationships materially dependent on Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, or the two largest PIT market-cap names?
questions.Q3: Are mean factor spreads driven by a small number of extreme winners, while median spreads and within-date rank correlations are weak?
questions.Q4: When fundamentals improve, do companies actually have negative absolute returns, or do they merely underperform KODEX200?
questions.Q5: Do the known relationships differ across signal-time benchmark trend / volatility states?

robustness.separateOutputs: The three headline views are computed independently and never substituted for one another.

statistics.belowThreshold: Dates under decileMinimumNames contribute no decile table; dates under rankCorrelationMinimumNames contribute nothing. Both counts are reported.
statistics.decileMinimumRationale: Fixed from design, before any outcome: 5 names per decile on average, the smallest count at which a decile median or beat-fraction is not decided by one or two stocks; v1's own minimumNamesPerDate (10) would give one name per decile. Input-coverage counts published in the v1 readiness record before any v1 outcome were consulted only to see which factors the threshold affects: ocfImprovementToAssets, the sparsest factor, is observed for about 8.5% of 2017, 43% of 2018 and 62-67% of 2019-2020 name-dates, so it forms deciles only from about 2018 and only barely then (about 51 of 120 names); no outcome was consulted.
decileOutputs: fraction beating the benchmark per decile
decile monotonicity (rank correlation of decile index with decile mean)
statistics.minimumDatesPerYearRationale: One calendar quarter of weekly signals; shorter years are tabulated but excluded from the positive-year fraction.
statistics.noFactorRanking: All factors are displayed side by side in frozen spec order and never sorted by result.

universe.membership: The anatomy's strictly-previous KRX monthly top-120 PIT membership, unchanged. No Top300, no survivor substitution, no zero fill.
universe.scopeStatement: SCOPE: point-in-time TOP-120 KRX market-capitalisation LARGE CAPS only (260 securities ever held that rank, 2013-2026). Nothing here describes the whole Korean market, mid caps or small caps.
universe.terminalDiscipline: Primary V1_TERMINAL_DISCIPLINE only (an observation contributes only if MATURED and ELIGIBLE under the sealed v1 terminal rule). The anatomy's ALL_OBSERVED_ENDPOINTS sensitivity is not repeated.

valueUpPolicyEra.note: 2024+ is treated only as calendar context already visible through chronology. The principal special-regime diagnostic is mega-cap / semiconductor concentration.

windowSlices.classification: By each observation's own entryDate and exitDate, never by signal year alone. A slice removes OUTCOMES only; same-date ranks are unchanged.
windowSlices.insufficientRule: A slice with fewer than labelRules.sliceMinimumDates dates with a decile spread is DATA_INSUFFICIENT; H252 has no valid TOUCHES_2026 data unless matured windows exist. No breakpoint is added after execution.
windowSlices.intersectsCalendarYear: entryDate <= YYYY-12-31 AND exitDate >= YYYY-01-01 (closed interval, ISO date comparison)
windowSlices.signalYearChronology: SIGNAL_YEAR tables (2015..2026) are context only and never define a slice.

slices.FULL_SAMPLE: every valid matured observation with a known entry and exit date
